description: A spatial database of wildfire occurrence and associated fire environment conditions in New Zealand is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Laura Kiely et al. As wildfire occurrence grows globally, research on wildfire is becoming increasingly important. Data on wildfire occurrence helps describe regional wildfire patterns, but in New Zealand this data can be difficult to find and is not always easily accessible. Coverage: national (NZ); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1470008893 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
